issues: Small 92px italic on two centred lines, squeezed into a thin band across the middle with large empty black areas above and below
The keyword is white before and after the gradient, so the before/after contrast is weak — it doesn't read as 'only this word got powered'
Flat near-black environment; the charge happens only on the type, nothing in the room lights up
Lightning was arbitrary zig-zags unrelated to the letterforms; nothing happens at the moment the sweep completes
changes: Look switched to aurora; left-aligned slogan poster: mono eyebrow → 230px / 800 'Supercharged' → 76px white body → hairline footer; the keyword is the only colour on screen

Before charging the keyword is an unpowered dim grey (ink 26%) next to pure-white body copy; a 4f 'inhale' anticipation (slight shrink, dimmer), then a spring kick of +2.4% (damping 13, one visible rebound) and glow peak the frame the sweep completes, decaying to steady state
The stage key light ramps 0.35→1.0 with the charge, a large soft glow behind the word unfolds with the wavefront and the dust brightens — the whole room is lit by the word
Lightning is now arcs jumping between letter tops (built from glyph heights), 6 scheduled flashes of 3–4f with a two-beat flicker; the three-layer thin magenta stroke is kept

New timeline: 0–20 entrance / 20–24 inhale / 24–42 sweep (EASE.out) / 46–86 lightning / 19f breathing tail, push-in 1→1.03; fixed the grey ghost on descenders that the gradient layers missed (line-height 1.3)
